title: Savoy scale versus Arcadia pay, and Lucky's nightly pay
summary: The Savoy paid $33 a week against the Arcadia's $50, but Lucky paid $11 a night on tour.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Oh? Hey, what was the approximate salary at the Savoy?
Well, the scale at the Savoy during those days was $33 a week.
$33 a week, yeah. It was a big drop for me, because at the Arcadia, the scale was $50 a week.
Right. But did you make more when you and Lucky went on tour? They paid nightly, didn't they?
Yeah, we got paid nightly. And at that time, they were paying like $7 or $8 a night, and Lucky was paying $11, so this was really big time -- he was paying $11 a night.
